INSERT INTO library_search_data (doc_id, doc_type, project_id, title_text, content_text, tags)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
               ON CONFLICT (doc_id, doc_type) DO UPDATE SET
                   title_text = EXCLUDED.title_text,
                   content_text = EXCLUDED.content_text,
                   tags = EXCLUDED.tags
